tool: Antigravity CLI (agy) 1.5.15 in print mode, run in an empty directory outside the repository: `agy -p "<request>" --model gemini-4-neon-high --mode accept-edits --sandbox --output-format json`. The agent hands the request to its built-in image-generator subagent, which writes the image prompt and calls its generate_image tool.
model: gemini-3.1-flash-image behind generate_image (the service named it in a capacity error of the same session; the tool does not report it on success); agent gemini-4-neon-high; image-generator subagent gemini-4-hydrogen-tiered-high.
prompt: A seamless tileable 3D PBR diffuse surface texture of clean flat brown corrugated kraft cardboard, filling 100% of the square frame edge to edge. Natural medium-brown kraft paper with fine visible paper fibres, subtle pulp specks, and light natural mottling. Faint, perfectly uniform, evenly spaced subtle vertical corrugated flute ridges running straight from top to bottom with identical spacing and intensity across the entire width, with absolutely no creases, no fold lines, no score lines, and no irregular bands. Viewed perfectly straight-on in an orthographic flat top-down view with zero perspective. Completely flat, shadowless, even diffuse lighting across the whole surface, with no shadows, no directional lighting, no specular highlights, no gradients, and no vignetting, so all four edges match seamlessly for tiling. Zero objects, zero text, zero logos, zero markings. Photorealistic material texture.
request: Generate exactly one image with aspect ratio 1:1 and nothing else. Image description: A seamless tileable surface texture of the outer face of a brown corrugated cardboard box: kraft paper with visible fine fibres, faint evenly spaced flute ridges running vertically, light natural mottling, viewed perfectly straight on (orthographic, top-down), completely flat even diffuse lighting, no shadows, no specular highlights, no vignetting, no perspective, no objects, no text, no logos, no markings, uniform detail across the whole frame so it can tile seamlessly in a 3D material, photorealistic, square.
postProcessing: 1. ImageMagick 7.1.2-36, a one-off conversion of the generated JPEG to an 8-bit RGB PNG: `magick source.jpg -strip -colorspace sRGB -type TrueColor PNG24:source.png`. 2. `bun tools/plant/textures.ts prepare cardboard source.png`: the last 128 columns and rows are cross-faded into the first ones (seamless, 896x896), the broad light and shade is removed (a wrapping box blur of radius 112 subtracted, the mean kept), and the image is area-averaged to 512x512. 3. `bun tools/plant/textures.ts derive` writes normal.png, roughness.png and metalness.png from basecolor.png.
